lessonTitle: 45. Units of length and measuring tools
lessonTitleEnglish: Units of length and measuring tools
source: Based on the topics of the Armenian grade 7 mathematics textbooks

stages.headline: The basic unit of length is the metre; there are also kilometres, decimetres, centimetres and millimetres.
stages.headlineEnglish: The basic unit of length is the metre; there are also kilometres, decimetres, centimetres and millimetres.

stages.headline: Segments are measured with a ruler, on the ground with a tape measure; put the ruler's 0 at one end of the segment.
stages.headlineEnglish: Segments are measured with a ruler, on the ground with a tape measure; put the ruler's 0 at one end of the segment.

stages.headline: When an end falls between marks, write the length approximately, to the nearest millimetre.
stages.headlineEnglish: When an end falls between marks, write the length approximately, to the nearest millimetre.

stages.headline: How many centimetres is 2 m 5 cm?
stages.headlineEnglish: How many centimetres is 2 m 5 cm?
